SELECT 'cal' k, fiscal_period::VARCHAR a, CAST(period_start_date AS VARCHAR) b, CAST(period_end_date AS VARCHAR) c, CAST(weeks_in_period AS VARCHAR) d, CAST(fully_loaded AS VARCHAR) e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period>=7
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cat', category, CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(min(valid_from) AS VARCHAR), CAST(max(valid_to) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT sku) AS VARCHAR) FROM dim_product GROUP BY category
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup', 'sales_lines', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS VARCHAR), '' FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-01' AND DATE '2025-05-31'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup', 'returns', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT return_line_id) AS VARCHAR), '', '' FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-01' AND DATE '2025-05-31'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales,
           s.store_id, p.category, (s.store_id = 900) AS is_web, (w.web_order_id IS NULL) AS no_dispatch
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net, s.store_id, p.category, (s.store_id = 900), false
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS garden_net_sales,
       SUM(CASE WHEN n.is_web THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS web_part,
       SUM(CASE WHEN n.no_dispatch AND n.is_web THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_nodispatch_rows
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.category = 'Garden' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2

WITH v AS (
  SELECT a.sku, a.category AS cat_from, b.category AS cat_to, a.subcategory sub_from, b.subcategory sub_to, b.valid_from
  FROM dim_product a JOIN dim_product b ON a.sku=b.sku AND a.valid_to + 1 = b.valid_from
  WHERE a.category <> b.category)
SELECT cat_from, cat_to, sub_from, sub_to, valid_from, count(*) n FROM v GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY valid_from

-- does fact product_key match the version valid on the sale date, for FY24/25 P7-P12 sales lines (stores only)?
SELECT count(*) AS lines,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS outside_validity,
       sum(CASE WHEN p.category='Garden' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS garden_lines,
       sum(CASE WHEN p.category='Garden' AND p.subcategory ILIKE '%light%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS garden_light_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
